tier.$comment: The five statistics tiers of Building Creatures, `unlimited | limited` only for area damage. Which of them a scale uses is the record's own `tiers`; the validator checks every row's keys against the record's list.

max.$comment: A range cell (`{ min, max }`) is Hit Points' '20–17', the low Skills tier's '+2 to +1', or a value under 'value' for a scale without tiers. min <= max is the validator's rule.

dice.$comment: The printed damage expression, same notation as a Strike's damage.

dc.$comment: Spell DC table prints both numbers per cell: this DC and the attack modifier.

attack.$comment: The spell attack modifier that shares the Spell DC table's cell.

cell.$comment: One cell of the table (one tier at one level): an integer modifier, a { min, max } range, a { dice, average } damage expression, or Spell DC's { dc, attack } pair. A printed '—' is no cell — the row keys lack the tier.

row.$comment: One level of the table: `level` and one cell per tier. A resistance table has no tiers — its single cell sits under the key `value`. Rows in order −1…24 without gaps is the validator's rule.

tiers.$comment: The scale's tiers in print order: the columns of the table ('extreme, high, moderate…'). Empty when the table has none — Resistance and Weaknesses prints a single value per level.

rows.$comment: One row per level, in ascending order.

text.$comment: The printed rule that says when each tier applies.
